title: Incorporating Geo-Diverse Knowledge into Prompting for Increased Geographical Robustness in Object Recognition

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot and soft-prompted vision-language model (CLIP) object recognition accuracy across different countries and continents (e.g., Africa, Asia, Americas vs. Europe/USA) using the DollarStreet and GeoNet datasets.
Measuring object recognition performance disparities across low, medium, and high household income brackets using the DollarStreet dataset.
